messages:
emma: Heads up — NVD just posted CVE-2026-2468 for Pillow 9.3.4 -> 9.6.0, reported as out-of-bounds read leading to memory corruption when parsing malformed JPEG/WEBP. Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-2468
secbot: New vuln signal: CVE-2026-2468. CVSS: 7.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H). EPSS: 0.12. Affects our dependency tree: python-service-image (requirements.txt pin pillow==9.5.2). Auto-scan flagged.
raj: Repro steps from report look like crafted image -> decode path. Any active user-upload endpoints that feed into our thumbnailer? /upload-image and /ingest-avatars maybe.
mira: yes, image-uploader (team: product-images) streams to thumbnailer svc (python-service-image). It runs as service account with write to bucket and KMS-encrypted keys for upload. No public WebACL, but uploads are unauthenticated for new accounts.
emma: Priority check: exploit available? There's a PoC gist in thread. secbot flagged EPSS but low observed exploit chatter. But memory corruption -> potential RCE via crafted payload.
devops-oncall: For mitigation, we can backport patch or pin to patched 9.7.0. What about rolling out a quick WAF rule to block suspicious content-type/large headers? Also need to consider KMS key exposure if attacker can upload object metadata that triggers a rotation.
raj: Action items: 1) owner-tag image-uploader, 2) urgent patch to pillow to 9.7.0 in staging, 3) run canary with fuzzed images to ensure no crash. Who picks?
mira: I can take owner-tag and run staging patch today. Need RBAC check: will patch pipeline trigger any privileged KMS operations? The deploy pipeline uses CI service account with limited KMS decrypt only, not encrypt.
emma: Confirmed: CI key only decrypt for secrets; runtime uses infra's KMS key to encrypt S3 objects. If we roll patch, need to ensure Deploy role in RBAC has 'secretsmanager:Update' — double-check.
secbot: Quick triage score: PRIORITY=High, FIX=Backport, MITIGATION=Temporary WAF rule + throttling, ATTACK_SURFACE=Unauthenticated image upload endpoint. Notes: open ticket #SEC-2026-014.
raj: commands I ran:
```
pip index versions pillow
python -c "from PIL import Image; print(Image.open('malformed.jpg'))"
```
mira: I'll run fuzz canary and post results here. tagging @devops-oncall for rollout window. :eyes: 
emma: thumbs up. If canary passes, escalate to production patch with canary window at 02:00 UTC. Keep audit logs of KMS operations during deploy. :thumbsup:
devops-oncall: noted, will add KMS audit retention for today's deploy. I'll also add RBAC temporary deny for create-bucket for deployers until patch lands.
secbot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-014 — adding watchers: emma, mira, raj, devops-oncall
mira: starting canary run now — will post results in ~30m.
